title: Model output (I/O contract of the system under test)
description: Two tracks. Answer-only and Grounded-answer are ranked separately and are not mixed into the same average. The evaluator computes context precision / fact_evidence_recall primarily from retrieved_contexts (including rank/chunk).

retrieved_contexts.description: Required. Based on the official canonical_chunks; custom chunking goes to free mode and does not enter the main leaderboard.

citations.description: Required for the Grounded-answer track; ignored for the Answer-only track.
